svg.title: Sanzeed stamp — round 40 mm (editable text)
svg.desc: Outer ring 0.7 mm, inner ring 0.5 mm, ring text Inter Tight Bold 7 pt (+0.10 em) on a 15.95 mm radius, symbol (the S with its full stop) 14 mm. 1 unit = 1 mm. Single colour black (100 K). No bleed — the stamp maker uses the outer cut circle/rectangle.

g.aria-label: SANZEED MIRZA · EXPERIENTIAL DESIGN CONSULTANT · NEW DELHI ·
